profile_text.body:
xAI is an AI company founded in 2023 and headquartered in the San Francisco Bay Area. The company describes itself as building frontier AI models for reasoning, voice, image generation, and more, and its primary product is Grok, an AI assistant with capabilities including voice chat, image and video generation, real-time search, and advanced reasoning. Grok is available directly at grok.com and through a Grok API for developers.

The held facts confirm that xAI maintains a tracked presence on theworldofai.org, with Grok listed under the Chat and General LLMs category. No litigation, MCP server registrations, SEC filings, or patent records are currently held for the company.
